Thirsty Juice Co. – Lime Tahiti 100ml
Introducing Thirsty Juice Co’s Lime Tahiti e-liquid – a flawless marriage of tangy citrus lime that’s now bottled just for you. With every puff, you’ll be transported to a tropical paradise, where the vibrant lime flavour dances on your taste buds.
